cleanup.title: Clean voice
cleanup.intro: Make speech clearer. You hear the result before anything changes, and one click puts your original back.
cleanup.pickClip: Select a clip with sound to clean it.
cleanup.readOnly: This timeline is read-only, so it cannot be changed.

basic.label: Basic
basic.hint: Softens steady background noise like a fan or room hum. Does not remove sudden sounds, music or other voices.

studio.label: Studio
studio.hint: Keeps the voice and removes almost everything else, even loud noise. Takes longer. It can make a voice sound slightly processed.

cleanup.noiseHint: Pick the one sound that bothers you.

hum.label: Hum
hum.hint: Removes a steady low buzz from lights or mains power. Does not touch the voice or other sounds.

wind.label: Wind
wind.hint: Softens wind rumble on outdoor recordings. Does not remove sharp gusts completely.

hiss.label: Hiss
hiss.hint: Softens the soft, steady hiss of a quiet room or an old microphone. Does not fix a muffled voice.

echo.label: Echo
echo.hint: Reduces the room echo that makes speech sound far away. Does not make a bad recording perfect.

music.label: Music
music.hint: Takes the background music out and keeps the talking. Very loud music may leave a trace.
